connector.name: Kr Dart Events
connector.registryDescription: Real-time Korean corporate disclosure (DART) events. Pay per call in USDC via x402. No API key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image kr-dart-events-mcp:0.1.4. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ljaysk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: EVM private key (0x...) of a wallet holding a few cents of USDC on Base. Used to sign x402 micro-payments. Gas is not needed.
